db:insert.doc:name: Insert Customer into MySQL
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, street, city, state, postal_code, country, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:customerId, :firstName, :lastName, :email, :phone, :dateOfBirth, :street, :city, :state, :postalCode, :country, :status, NOW(), NOW())

db:select.doc:name: Query Customers from MySQL
db:select.db:sql: SELECT customer_id AS customerId, first_name AS firstName, last_name AS lastName, email, phone, date_of_birth AS dateOfBirth, street, city, state, postal_code AS postalCode, country, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM customers WHERE (:email IS NULL OR email = :email) AND (:name IS NULL OR first_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :name, '%') OR last_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :name, '%')) AND (:status IS NULL OR status = :status)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (item) -> { customerId: item.customerId, firstName: item.firstName, lastName: item.lastName, email: item.email, phone: item.phone, dateOfBirth: item.dateOfBirth, address: { street: item.street, city: item.city, state: item.state, postalCode: item.postalCode, country: item.country }, status: item.status, createdAt: item.createdAt, updatedAt: item.updatedAt }

db:update.doc:name: Update Customer in MySQL
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE customers SET first_name = COALESCE(:firstName, first_name), last_name = COALESCE(:lastName, last_name), email = COALESCE(:email, email), phone = COALESCE(:phone, phone), date_of_birth = COALESCE(:dateOfBirth, date_of_birth), street = COALESCE(:street, street), city = COALESCE(:city, city), state = COALESCE(:state, state), postal_code = COALESCE(:postalCode, postal_code), country = COALESCE(:country, country), status = COALESCE(:status, status), updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = :customerId
